title: 学术三态判断：档案库环境记录
instruction: 阅读完整材料，判断每条陈述：TRUE表示材料支持，FALSE表示材料提供矛盾信息，NOT GIVEN表示材料既未支持也未反驳。只依据本文，不用外部知识补充。
source_notice: 题型参照既存官方学术阅读样题包12—14页：一份自成输入的节选支撑三陈述，TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN，不能用外部知识补信息。官方完整题面/键已核图，原传记史实未另做事实核证，原文本出版许可不转授本项目。新增稿件全为虚构原创案例，不复制原材料；此为高级档的学术任务形式参照，不新增雅思备考档，不证明产品难度、CEFR/分数等值、教师/学生标定、商用或生产通过。其他官方学术阅读具体形式仍待逐项复核。
paragraphs: A research brief from the fictional Bellmere Archive describes an attempt to compare indoor humidity records collected in two different decades. The earlier measurements were written in notebooks by a caretaker using a portable analogue instrument. A later monitoring scheme installed digital sensors permanently beside selected shelves. Although both schemes recorded humidity, the researchers did not treat their numbers as directly interchangeable. They first examined calibration notes and excluded intervals during which either instrument was awaiting repair. The comparison concerned the remaining records, rather than every measurement that had originally been collected.

The project was financed by a grant from a local historical foundation. This paid for the transcription of the notebooks, the checking of shelf codes and a short period in which the old instrument and a modern sensor were operated side by side. Volunteers entered the handwritten numbers into a spreadsheet, while a second reader checked entries against photographs of the original pages. When a figure could not be read confidently, it was retained as an unresolved entry instead of being replaced with a plausible value. The grant report listed these procedures as separate expenditure categories.

For the final climate map, a usable observation had to carry both a date and a shelf code. A measurement without either identifier could still be mentioned in the archive’s narrative history, but it was not assigned a location on the map. The authors cautioned that an apparent difference between two periods might reflect changes in measurement practice as well as changes in the building itself. They therefore presented the map as a tool for deciding where to investigate next, rather than as proof that a particular storage policy had caused the observed pattern.

questions.stem: The researchers compared the two periods using records made with the same measuring device.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.evidence_quote: The earlier measurements were written in notebooks by a caretaker using a portable analogue instrument.
questions.rationale: TRUE：两期记录确实比较，但“同一器具”与旧模拟仪/新固定数字传感器相矛盾；FALSE：旧期portable analogue与后期digital sensors为不同设备，不能把同测湿度等同同一器具；NOT GIVEN：两期器具都明确写出，不属于缺信息

questions.stem: The project was chosen because it would cost less than moving the archive’s collection.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.rationale: TRUE：资金用于校录和并行测量，不等于低于搬迁成本，更未说明以此选择项目；FALSE：没有相反的成本比较或选项决策记录，不能仅因未支持便判FALSE；NOT GIVEN：全文写经费用途及限制，却未给搬迁比较和选题因果，因而既不支持也不反驳

questions.stem: Only observations carrying both identifiers were given a position on the final climate map.
options: 材料给出与陈述矛盾的信息
材料既未支持也未反驳该陈述
questions.evidence_quote: For the final climate map, a usable observation had to carry both a date and a shelf code.
questions.rationale: TRUE：必须同时有日期及架号，缺任一不在图上定位，陈述一致；FALSE：原文支持而非反驳两标识条件；NOT GIVEN：所需条件与缺标识后果都明文给出，不是缺信息
